reviewer: ChatGPT independent_art_qa subagent; no production-code or geometry edits
G3_basis: Producer saved-file audit independently read: 3 per-mesh failures and 49 surface-crossing pairs; not independently reexecuted by art reviewer. Images alone do not certify structure.

findings.finding: Broad planar quarry cuts dominate the exposed stone faces. Abrupt transitions between nearly featureless planes and concentrated rough facets read as cut-and-fitted scan fragments, rather than coherently weathered masonry.
findings.canonical_delta: The approved CG shows weathered stone faces with moderate, consistent relief and softened irregular outlines.

findings.finding: Several stones terminate in acute triangular points and strong planar diagonals. The wall reads as a polygon puzzle with alternating smooth wedges and jagged patches; nonrectangular domains alone do not establish a natural stone bond.

Coping stones have very broad flat upper surfaces, razor-like rims and apparent undercut/lifted corners. Their bearing against the body is visually inconsistent; the intended abutment and arch are not yet convincing as a unified masonry construction.

Joints vary from hairline seams to conspicuous dark openings, and the footing looks like several thin cut slabs with a dark underside gap. Recessed mortar/bedding does not read consistently at the exposed interfaces.

Large flat left/rear/end surfaces are declared cutaway planes by the producer. Their presence is not counted as a facade defect, but these views do not establish finished external return-face or terrain/road integration quality.

positive_observations: Actual three neutral-clay PNGs and a Blender candidate exist; this is a real generated model, not a plan.
Nonrectangular stone outlines and an explicit radial half-arch differ visibly from the failed five-course rounded-block layout.
Cutaway profile makes the intended abutment/arch relationship inspectable, without claiming completed full-bridge placement.
game_scale_review: NOT_RUN: supplied camera renders are 1280x1024 close/study views, not verified final-display-size game captures. Native-size review already finds blocking G2 defects.
structural_certification: NOT_RUN: visual thickness/contact cannot replace closed-mesh, volumetric overlap and support checks.
disposition: CANDIDATE_REJECTED_FOR_ADOPTION; preserve all files and hashes. Do not claim CI or high source LOD implies G2 PASS.
root_cause_hypothesis: Oversized scan solids intersected with authored 2D bond prisms create dominant planar cut faces and acute seam corners; low source LOD further exposes faceting. Source-LOD selection and contact repair can be tested, but high LOD alone is not evidence of a solved art defect.
next_review_conditions: Inspect actual corrected three-view clay PNGs before a new G2 decision.
Demonstrate improved exposed-face relief/edge transitions and credible coping/bedding, rather than only increased vertex count.
Keep formal coordinates/scale G1 BLOCKED and game/Android G4 NOT_RUN.
